Trade Talks Resume As Ministers Meet In Geneva

Share Save Add as preferred on Google
Imran Rahman-JonesTechnology reporter

Negotiators from twelve countries resumed stalled trade talks on Monday, with ministers signalling a willingness to compromise on agricultural tariffs for the first time in three years. The talks, hosted in Geneva, are expected to run through the end of the week.

28.1k 2222 gold badges 124124 silver badges

Observers cautioned that previous rounds collapsed at a similar stage, but delegates described the current mood as pragmatic. A draft framework could be circulated to member governments before the weekend, according to two people familiar with the discussions.
